en.headline: MTR issues non-compliance notice over Tung Chung West station columns
en.dek: The operator said it issued the notice on Monday after about 30 columns were found substandard and is awaiting a remedial proposal from contractors.
body: The MTR Corporation said on Monday that it had issued a non-compliance notice to the contractors responsible for construction of the Tung Chung West station.

The notice followed the discovery of about 30 substandard columns at the site. The operator said it was strictly following up on the mistakes by the relevant contractors, their handling of the matter and questions of responsibility.

According to the MTR, it is awaiting a comprehensive report from the contractors together with a remedial proposal. The company said it would continue inspections and other monitoring measures to ensure the quality of the works.

The MTR said it would maintain close contact with relevant government departments so that safety and quality meet contractual standards both during construction and on completion. It added that it would fully cooperate with the government probe into the incident and submit a report on the cause, the remedial plan and follow-up actions with the contractors.
The operator reiterated that it would not tolerate any substandard engineering practices and would seriously follow up on the matter.

zh.headline: 港鐵向東涌西站承建商發出不合規通知
zh.dek: 港鐵表示周一就約30條欠妥支柱向承建商發出通知，正等候全面報告及補救方案。
body: 港鐵公司表示，已就東涌西站工程向負責的承建商發出不合規通知。
有關通知是在發現約30條支柱施工質素欠妥後發出。港鐵指正嚴格跟進承建商的失誤、處理方式及責任問題。
港鐵表示正等候承建商提交全面報告及補救建議。公司會繼續進行巡查及其他監察措施，以確保工程質素。
港鐵稱會與相關政府部門保持緊密聯繫，確保工程在施工期間及完工後均符合合約安全及質素標準。公司會全力配合政府調查事件，並按時提交有關成因、補救計劃及與承建商跟進行動的報告。
港鐵重申不會容忍任何欠妥工程做法，並會嚴肃跟進此事。
